methodology.additions: Annual net additions = year-end capacity minus previous year-end capacity, from the rounded values; retirements are netted out
methodology.capacity: Year-end installed photovoltaic capacity (on-grid + off-grid, without concentrated solar power), GW, rounded to 3 decimals
methodology.known_source_issue: From 2022 IRENA reports less German capacity than the Bundesnetzagentur/AGEE-Stat (end of 2022: 61.2 vs. about 66.5 GW; 2022 net addition 1.2 vs. 7.2 GW); values are used as published, so Germany's shares since 2022 are rather understated
methodology.learning_rate: OLS of log2(module price) on log2(global cumulative on-grid PV capacity in MW); learning rate = 1 - 2^slope; descriptive fit, not a causal estimate
methodology.price: Module price only (no installation or system costs), constant 2025 US$ per watt
methodology.shares: Germany's share = Germany / world total, from the rounded values, in percent
methodology.statistics_input: Rounded values in pv_lernkurve_jahre.csv and pv_lernkurve_lernkurve.csv
